name: sheffield-masjids
description: Look up published mosque prayer times (adhan and iqamah) from Sheffield Masjids.

interface.shortDescription: Mosque prayer times: adhan and iqamah for listed mosques.
interface.longDescription: Ask for today's or a specific day's prayer times for mosques published on Sheffield Masjids. Search the directory, then get adhan and iqamah with Europe/London timezone. Powered by the same published timetable data used by Masjidly.
defaultPrompt: What are today's prayer times at Madina Masjid Sheffield?
Search Sheffield mosques named Huda, then get tonight's Maghrib and Isha iqamah.
When is Maghrib at Muslim Welfare House Sheffield on 2026-04-10?

review.release_notes: Remote MCP plugin: search_mosques and get_prayer_times over published Sheffield Masjids timetable data, including Ramadan overrides and year coverage checks.

positive.description: Today's times for a known mosque slug
positive.prompt: Get today's prayer times for madina-masjid-sheffield
positive.expected_behavior: Returns adhan and iqamah for Europe/London today with mosque metadata.

positive.description: Resolve mosque by name then fetch a dated timetable
positive.prompt: What are Fajr and Maghrib at Madina Masjid Sheffield on 2026-04-10?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the mosque and reports separate adhan and iqamah values for 2026-04-10.

positive.prompt: Find Sheffield mosques with Huda in the name
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching Sheffield directory entries with slugs and URLs.
Returns the published Ramadan timetable for that day, not the monthly February row.

positive.prompt: What time is Asr iqamah in Sheffield today?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which mosque or lists candidates because iqamah varies by mosque.

negative.prompt: Calculate prayer times for a random GPS coordinate with no mosque
